title: System File Paths as Raw Strings
pattern: Representing system resources (file paths, directories) as raw `String` parameters.
why_bad: A raw string has no path safety: it can represent structurally invalid paths (e.g., containing null bytes, illegal characters, or control sequences), leading to fragile platform-specific handling and runtime crashes.
detection: Passing raw `String` variables representing file system locations to internal file-handling routines.
counterexample: Parsing path arguments from a terminal command array at the application's entry boundary.
